gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 identifies the same incorrect numerical contribution: the displayed square-root logarithm is half of the V1 term in the governing bound, causing the onset contribution to be understated by a factor of two. Its repair gives the corrected formula and value.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the erroneous replacement of (1/2)log(1/(1−V1)) by (1/2)log(1/sqrt(1−V1)), which halves the numerical contribution and requires recomputation from approximately 1.6844 to approximately 3.37/3.3688.

component_coverage.gold_component: The illustrative contribution uses a square-root logarithm instead of the governing bound's (1/2)log(1/(1−V1)), making the value too small by a factor of two.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly compares the displayed square-root expression with the actual bound term, quantifies the factor-of-two understatement, states the resulting effect, and supplies the corrected expression and approximate value.
